text: 【央行：7月份个人住房新发放贷款加权平均利率约3.1%】从中国人民银行获悉，今年以来，我国贷款利率保持低位水平，7月延续下行态势。7月份，企业新发放贷款加权平均利率略低于3%，比上年同期低约0.2个百分点；个人住房新发放贷款加权平均利率约3.1%，与上年同期基本持平。
text_en: [PBOC: Weighted average interest rate on new individual housing loans in July was approximately 3.1%] According to the People's Bank of China, loan interest rates in China have remained at low levels this year and continued their downward trend in July. In July, the weighted average interest rate on new corporate loans was slightly below 3%, about 0.2 percentage points lower than the same period last year; the weighted average interest rate on new individual housing loans was approximately 3.1%, roughly flat with the same period last year.
